scientific_integrity: The theorem concerns independent homogeneous species losses and disjoint nonempty function groups. Source probability laws and basic moments are not claimed as new; the sharp universal transfer-threshold and sign classification are the target.
scientific_limitations: No correlated or heterogeneous species extinctions, multifunctional species, or cascades.
The high-extinction sufficient bound is not a fixed-size optimal boundary.
Historical priority of the variance-transfer classification is not independently established.
title: A universal extinction-probability threshold for functional-redundancy variance under balancing
